title: Parameter file of tpg-network-policy
description: The parameter file of `argo submit --from workflowtemplate/tpg-network-policy --parameter-file`: the inputs of the WorkflowTemplate tpg-network-policy. Generated from workflows/params/types.yaml and the template by workflows/params/params_schema.py. The shape, the types, the allowed values and the mandatory inputs; the validate step of the workflow and the admission policy tpg-workflow-parameters remain the authority (inputs that are mandatory in some cases only, combinations, registered clusters, the inside of clusterMap).

clusters.description: List: registered clusters in brackets, [aks-tpg-poc-01] (also with one value) (without clusterMap) [List; mandatory in some cases (the validate step decides)]

instances.description: List: instances in brackets, [orders-db], on every listed cluster; each must be declared there (without clusterMap) [List; mandatory in some cases (the validate step decides)]

clusterMap.description: Map (YAML or JSON): cluster -> {instances: {instance -> {ingressFromNamespaces, ingressFromPodLabels, ingressFromCidrs, egressToCidrs, egressToFqdns, postgresVersion (guard)}}}; the inputs below are the defaults [Map]

mode.description: apply: baseline policy with exactly these rules; update: change only the rules given; remove: delete both policies [Enum; mandatory]

pushMode.description: direct: push to the fleet branch; pr: open a pull request and continue after it is merged [Enum; mandatory]

ingressFromNamespaces.description: List in brackets, [orders-app]: namespaces whose pods may connect on 5432 [List]

ingressFromPodLabels.description: Map (YAML or JSON): pod labels allowed to connect on 5432 (in ingressFromNamespaces, or any namespace) [Map]

ingressFromCidrs.description: List of CIDRs in brackets, [10.30.0.0/24]: allowed to connect on 5432 (clients outside the cluster, through a load balancer) [List (CIDRs)]

egressToCidrs.description: List of CIDRs in brackets, [10.40.0.0/24]: extra CIDRs the instance pods may reach [List (CIDRs)]

egressToFqdns.description: List in brackets, [api.example.com, *.example.org]: host names the instance pods may reach (CiliumNetworkPolicy toFQDNs; needs ACNS) [List (host names)]

connectivityCheck.description: true: after the sync, check WAL archiving and run probe pods (an allowed namespace, and default) [Boolean]

rolloutMode.description: canary: one wave-0 cluster first, then batches of maxParallel; batches: no canary; all: every cluster at once [Enum]

dryRun.description: true: plan and dry-run the policies on each cluster; push and sync nothing [Boolean]
